About

The Pantry by the Polo Lounge

A café stop inside one of Gulberg's best-known shopping addresses — suited to a coffee break during shopping, a relaxed lunch, or dinner with family and friends.

Inside Mall 1

You'll find The Pantry at Shop No 10, Mall 1, 94-D Main Boulevard Gulberg, Block D1, Gulberg III. Its mall setting makes it an easy, central meeting point in Gulberg — no separate trip needed if you're already shopping or working nearby.

  • Wood-fired pizza & herbed cheese pizza
  • Sandwiches, burgers, pasta & lasagna
  • Quinoa salad, cheesecake & coffee

Good to know

Public listings rate The Pantry 4.2 stars from 1,222 Google reviews. A publicly listed guide range puts a visit at around Rs 1,000–2,000 per person — please confirm current menu prices in the café, as this demo does not list item prices.
